name: PDF Converter
description: Convert PDF, Word documents, PNG and JPG images between supported formats.

name: PDF Merger
description: Merge multiple PDF files into one document and arrange their page order.

name: PDF Split
description: Split a PDF document into separate files for each page.

name: Quick Search
description: Search the web or open websites in a tabbed browser inside Notcher.

name: Share Screen
description: Share a display or window with another Notcher user over a direct peer-to-peer connection using invitation and response codes.

name: Extended Display
description: Extend the Windows desktop across monitors already connected to your PC and view active displays.

name: Screen Recorder
description: Record a connected display to an MP4 video, with pause, resume, a live preview and recording duration.

name: Focus Timer
description: Stay focused with a Pomodoro timer, adjustable focus sessions, short and long breaks, pause and completion reminders.

name: Color Picker
description: Pick a color from any connected display and copy its HEX or RGB value.

name: Live Lyrics
description: Follow time-synced song lyrics from LRCLIB in a compact popup linked to Notcher music playback, with local caching and automatic song matching.

name: Image Resizer
description: Resize images in pixels, keep aspect ratio and save a new PNG, JPG or WebP copy offline, with preview and compression quality.

name: Text Tools
description: Clean text offline: uppercase, lowercase, title case, trim spaces, remove duplicate or blank lines, sort lines, count words and characters, undo and copy.

name: Unit Converter
description: Convert length, weight, temperature, data sizes and area offline, with instant results, unit swapping and clipboard copy. Supports metric and imperial units.

name: Quick Translation
description: Translate selected text in a compact popup with local language detection, automatic region preferences, and saved choices. Translation is sent to MyMemory.
